Scenario fixture: media-transcript-adjacent (RGAA 4.1.1 to 4.1.3)

Each target has a stable id of the form mta_case_NN. RGAA 4.1 accepts a transcript, or a link or button to one, placed just before or just after the media in the code. Anything else is asked about.

A. No adjacent transcript (CANTTELL)

01 — CANTTELL: video with nothing around it
02 — CANTTELL: transcript referenced by aria-describedby, further down

Recorded in March.

Transcript: Hello and welcome to the annual meeting.
03 — CANTTELL: a paragraph comes between the audio and the transcript link

Episode 12, 25 minutes.

Transcript
04 — CANTTELL: autoplaying audio without controls
05 — CANTTELL: the adjacent transcript link is hidden
Transcript

B. Adjacent transcript or link (PASS)

06 — PASS: link to the transcript just after the audio
Transcription
07 — PASS: button just before the video
Hello and welcome.
08 — PASS: transcript block just after the video
Transcript

Hello and welcome.

C. Out of scope (NOT APPLICABLE)

09 — NOT APPLICABLE: video in a hidden container
